text:
sarah: T-minus 30 to the deploy for rc-2026-03. runtime hotfix PR #9123 is blocking the merge hold — need 2x LGTM before cutoff. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/9123 @tom @rika can you eyeball? oncall and deploy-bot FYI.

 tom: on it, doing a quick smoke run now, will report in ~5. ping me if anything looks off.

 deploy-bot: preflight checks started: ci/acceptance, ci/smoke, ci/lint (ETA ~6m).

 rika: skimmed the diff — small change to allocator behavior, left an inline comment about a potential race on the idle path (line ~243). overall looks low-risk. if @mike can take the second signoff I can +1 after tom's smoke and CI.

 tom: smoke is clean on my env. found one flaky assertion in test-sim that I fixed in a tiny follow-up; pushing patch now. patch snippet:
```
- if (cache.empty()) return;
+ if (!cache) return; // guard against freed pointer (fix flake)
```
re-running CI.

 rika: thanks — confirming the change addresses the race I flagged. re-approving once CI is green :thumbsup:.

 mike: I can give the second signoff in ~10m. quick question — does this touch any persisted state or require migration?

 sarah: no DB/schema changes. purely runtime memory handling. rollback plan is standard (revert PR + restart pool).

 tom: CI rerun looks good, all checks passed locally and in GH actions.

 deploy-bot: ci: all checks passed (ci/acceptance ✓, ci/smoke ✓, ci/lint ✓).

 rika: giving +1 (approved) :white_check_mark:.

 mike: giving +2 (second approve). merging after fetch to avoid race.

 deploy-bot: merge triggered by mike — merge commit created. scheduling deploy to canary now.

 sarah: merged and canary started. outbound release notice queued for release channel in 5. cutting the window — thanks everyone for quick turnaround. :rocket:
